response.sql: WITH per_order_avg AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), benchmark1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as val FROM per_order_avg), filtered1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, avg_fillcount, avg_fillcount - (SELECT val FROM benchmark1) as margin1 FROM per_order_avg WHERE avg_fillcount > (SELECT val FROM benchmark1)), benchmark2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as val FROM filtered1), filtered2 AS (SELECT ordersmark, avg_fillcount, margin1, avg_fillcount - (SELECT val FROM benchmark2) as margin2 FROM filtered1 WHERE avg_fillcount > (SELECT val FROM benchmark2)) SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) as avg_margin_vs_benchmark1, AVG(margin2) as avg_margin_vs_benchmark2 FROM filtered2
